categories.name: Corporate
categories.description: Legal entity, ownership and corporate decisions.

categories.name: Registration
categories.description: Formation, articles, registrations and legal entity records.

categories.name: Ownership
categories.description: Shareholder registers, capitalization tables and ownership records.

categories.name: Governance
categories.description: Board and shareholder decisions, minutes and delegated authorities.

categories.name: Human resources
categories.description: Employment, organization and employee records.

categories.name: Organization
categories.description: Organization charts, job descriptions and aggregate workforce information.

categories.name: Employment policies
categories.description: Employment rules, benefits policies and employee handbooks.

categories.name: Employment records
categories.description: Individual employment agreements, onboarding, leave and departure records. Payroll payments belong to FP.

categories.name: Recruiting
categories.description: Job postings, applications and hiring records.

categories.name: Appraisals
categories.description: Individual performance, disciplinary and development records.

categories.name: Finance
categories.description: Financial position, accounting, tax and payments.

categories.name: Financial statements
categories.description: Financial statements, financial audit reports and consolidated results. Supporting accounting evidence belongs to FA.

categories.name: Budgets
categories.description: Budgets, financial forecasts and financial models.

categories.name: Tax
categories.description: Tax returns, assessments and tax authority correspondence. Employee withholding belongs to FP.

categories.name: Cash and banking
categories.description: Bank statements, payments, treasury and account documentation. Excludes credentials and financing agreements, which belong to RA.

categories.name: Accounting evidence
categories.description: Ledgers, invoices, receipts and accounting evidence. Underlying contracts follow the relationship.

categories.name: Payroll
categories.description: Payroll registers, payslips, payroll calculations and employee tax withholding. Employment terms belong to HE.

categories.name: Sales and marketing
categories.description: Customers, commercial partnerships and market-facing work.

categories.name: Sales materials
categories.description: Proposals, quotes, sales materials and commercial analysis. Fundraising presentations belong to RP.

categories.name: Marketing
categories.description: Brand assets, campaigns, advertising and market research, including images and video.

categories.name: Customer records
categories.description: Customer agreements, orders, correspondence and service records. Invoice originals belong to FA.

categories.name: Commercial partners
categories.description: Distribution, referral and commercial partnership records. Procurement belongs to OS.

categories.name: Products and services
categories.description: What the company delivers to customers.

categories.name: Product overview
categories.description: Product and service descriptions, catalogs and user-facing manuals. Persuasive sales materials belong to SS.

categories.name: Development
categories.description: Specifications, designs, architecture, roadmaps and development records.

categories.name: Quality
categories.description: Testing, quality control, defects and acceptance records. Formal certifications belong to LC.

categories.name: Operations
categories.description: Operating the company, facilities, procurement and internal systems.

categories.name: Operating procedures
categories.description: Internal operating procedures and continuity plans. Employment rules belong to HP and security policies to LS.

categories.name: Assets and facilities
categories.description: Asset registers, premises, leases, equipment and maintenance records.

categories.name: Suppliers
categories.description: Procurement, supplier agreements, correspondence and supply-chain records.

categories.name: Internal IT
categories.description: Internal IT administration, software subscriptions and routine incidents. Security incidents belong to LS. Never store credentials.

categories.name: Intellectual property
categories.description: Ownership, registration and licensing of intellectual property.

categories.name: IP rights
categories.description: Patents, trademarks, copyright ownership and intellectual property registrations.

categories.name: IP licenses
categories.description: Grants, assignments and acquisition of IP rights. Routine software subscriptions belong to OI.

categories.name: Legal and compliance
categories.description: Legal obligations, regulation and risk.

categories.name: Regulatory compliance
categories.description: Permits, certifications, regulatory filings and compliance assessments.

categories.name: Security and privacy
categories.description: Security and privacy policies, assessments and incidents.

categories.name: Disputes
categories.description: Claims, litigation, legal opinions and dispute records.

categories.name: Insurance
categories.description: Insurance policies, coverage and claims.

categories.name: Raising capital
categories.description: Raising equity or debt and communicating with capital providers.

categories.name: Financing presentations
categories.description: Fundraising decks and investment or financing narratives. Source financial statements remain in FS.

categories.name: Financing agreements
categories.description: Equity and debt agreements, term sheets and financing negotiations. Resulting ownership registers belong to CO and resolutions to CG.

categories.name: Investor reporting
categories.description: Investor and lender updates and correspondence outside agreement negotiations.

categories.name: General company records
categories.description: Company-wide records outside a specific business function; not miscellaneous storage.

categories.name: Company profile
categories.description: Company introductions, history, mission and general company plans. Financing presentations belong to RP.

categories.name: Company communications
categories.description: General company announcements and communication records.

categories.name: Company events
categories.description: Company events and culture records, including event photos and recordings.

categories.name: Inbox
categories.description: Unclassified or ambiguous documents. Choose X when context does not identify a destination. Do not invent missing facts.
